scenarios.title: Initial access simulation
scenarios.red: Validate the approved entry path against the isolated lab service.
scenarios.blue: Confirm alert, triage owner, and evidence capture steps.
scenarios.success: Alert acknowledged within 10 minutes; no out-of-scope systems touched.
scenarios.safety: Listed lab asset only; stop on any unexpected production signal.

scenarios.title: Credential exposure response
scenarios.blue: Rotate synthetic credentials and preserve an auditable timeline.
scenarios.success: Containment decision recorded with timestamps and owner sign-off.
scenarios.safety: Synthetic credentials only; no real secrets or external accounts.

scenarios.title: Lessons-learned review
scenarios.red: Provide observations without repeating live actions.
scenarios.blue: Map detections, gaps, and remediation owners.
scenarios.success: Joint after-action record accepted by the White Cell.
scenarios.safety: Review evidence remains scoped to the exercise dataset.
